newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 4.9 pct vs. year ago--EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 4.9 pct vs. year ago--EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 65,844 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended February 15, up 4.9 percent from the same period in 1996, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said.
The amount of weekly power supplied to the South Central area showed the largest rise, up 17.6 percent to 8,592 GWh, EEI said.
The New England region experienced the largest decrease in power output, falling 7.8 percent from the corresponding period a year earlier to 2,348 GWh.
Year-to-date domestic power production ended February 15 totaled 456,732 GWh, almost unchanged from the same period in 1996, EEI said.
